summary: The hybrid worker can onboard your Windows servers, and the Jobs page shows at once if the worker has stopped.

new.title: Server onboarding on the hybrid worker
new.text: Discovery offers each Windows server without a PIM group; Create stages its per-server group. The hybrid worker then adds that group to the server's local Administrators and never removes anyone.

new.title: The hybrid worker on the Jobs page
new.text: Every on-premises AD job shows where it runs: on the worker (green), plan-only (amber) or worker not seen (red). A stopped worker is visible at once.

fixes.title: Clearer rules for custom Manager names
fixes.text: A custom Manager name is optional. On an environment reachable from the internet it must be a public subdomain you own; private names are refused with the options.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: The hybrid worker's setup now defaults to a 4 GB virtual machine.
